title: Shape each platform variant and choose its media
description: Keep the canonical draft separate from platform-specific copy. Media is selected explicitly per variant so publishing never guesses which private asset to send.
choosePost: Choose a draft post before editing platform variants.
mediaSelectionHint: Choose assets for this platform and order them explicitly. Publishing uses only this ordered selection.
saveVariantFirst: Save this platform variant before selecting media.
emptySelection: No media is selected for this platform variant.
noMedia: Upload media to the canonical post before selecting assets here.
invalidVariant: Enter valid platform copy and check the optional link.
variantLoadFailed: Platform variants could not be loaded.
selectionLoadFailed: The selected media for this platform could not be loaded.
variantSaveFailed: The platform variant could not be saved. Try again.
selectionSaveFailed: The media selection could not be saved. Check that every asset still belongs to this post.

publishNow.title: Publish now
publishNow.description: Choose an eligible API destination and submit this saved platform variant to the durable publication queue.
publishNow.saveVariantFirst: Save a platform variant before preparing a publication.
publishNow.readinessFailed: RecruitOps could not check publication readiness.

blockingReasons.POST_NOT_READY: Mark the canonical post READY before starting the publication workflow.
blockingReasons.NO_ELIGIBLE_API_DESTINATION: No enabled API destination with a connected, unexpired account is available for this platform.

publishNow.destinationHint: Only enabled destinations on the same platform with a connected, unexpired social account are listed.
publishNow.readOnly: Your role can review readiness but cannot start a publication.
publishNow.queueDisclaimer: Queued means the dispatch request was accepted. It does not mean the social provider has published the post yet.
publishNow.alreadyAccepted: This publication request was already accepted. Current state: {state}.
publishNow.queueUnconfirmed: Queue acceptance could not be confirmed. Retry this action without changing the destination; RecruitOps will reuse the same publication ID to avoid duplicates.
publishNow.publishFailed: RecruitOps could not start this publication. Refresh readiness and try again.

schedule.title: Schedule & calendar
schedule.description: Choose a local date and time for this saved platform variant. RecruitOps stores the resulting instant and calls the provider only when the delayed queue job becomes due.
schedule.saveVariantFirst: Save a platform variant before scheduling publication.
schedule.timeZone: Device timezone: {value}. The selected local time is converted to an absolute instant before it is stored.
schedule.readOnly: Your role can inspect the publication calendar but cannot schedule a publication.
schedule.futureRequired: Choose a valid date and time in the future.
schedule.queueUnconfirmed: Delayed queue acceptance could not be confirmed. Retry without changing the destination, date, or time; RecruitOps will reuse the same publication ID.
schedule.scheduleFailed: RecruitOps could not create this schedule. Refresh readiness and check the selected time before trying again.
schedule.alreadyAccepted: This schedule request was already accepted. Current state: {state}.
schedule.calendarEmpty: No scheduled dispatches are currently persisted for this platform variant.
schedule.overdue: Past due — refresh status or check worker health
schedule.calendarTruncated: The publication history is truncated to the 50 most recent attempts, so older scheduled entries may not appear here.

publicationStatus.title: Status, errors and retry
publicationStatus.description: Review recent dispatch state for this platform variant. Automatic retries remain worker-owned; manual retry is available only when the previous provider outcome is known to have failed.
publicationStatus.saveVariantFirst: Save a platform variant before reviewing publication status.
publicationStatus.loadFailed: RecruitOps could not load publication status.
publicationStatus.empty: No publication attempts exist for this platform variant yet.
publicationStatus.retryFailed: RecruitOps could not confirm this manual retry. Refresh status before trying again.
publicationStatus.manualReviewRequired: Manual retry is blocked because the previous provider outcome may be ambiguous or the publication identity needs review. Verify the provider before taking another action.
publicationStatus.readOnly: Your role can inspect failures but cannot retry publications.
publicationStatus.truncated: Showing the 50 most recent publication attempts for this variant.

retryAcceptance.RETRIED: The failed BullMQ job was moved back to the waiting queue.
retryAcceptance.REENQUEUED: The retained failed job was no longer present, so RecruitOps safely created a new queue job with the same publication identity.
retryAcceptance.ALREADY_QUEUED: This publication is already waiting or being processed; no duplicate retry was added.
